results.title: I Am Mario
results.overview: Mario is a trans taxi driver who gets pregnant. He has the possibility of fulfilling his desire to become a father, but this confronts him with his expectations regarding his masculinity. Before exposing himself to a "macho" and prejudice-filled society, he must face himself.

results.title: Fat
results.overview: A father obsessed with his own physique decides to force his overweight son to slim down, to the point of no return.

results.title: Untitled Woman
results.overview: An elegant, meticulously composed character study set at an art class with a charismatic teacher, middle-aged woman longing to be seen, and a delightful group of eccentrics eager to gaze.

results.title: Cantona
results.overview: Told largely in his own words, the remarkable story of Eric Cantona's journey from volatile French prodigy to Manchester United legend.

results.title: Mommy Down to the Ride
results.overview: A strict physics teacher tries to talk her teenage son out of dropping out of school and becoming a professional skateboarder. She makes a bet with him that if she competes in a major skateboarding competition, he will stay in school. Under the tutorship of one of her poorest pupils, she learns to skate, unaware that she's putting her career and reputation at stake.

results.title: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
results.overview: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

results.title: The Patron
results.overview: The cleaner moves like a nameless shadow on the fringes of cultural capital. When one of her employers — a wealthy art benefactor — leaves town, the door to another life suddenly opens, allowing her to step forward as someone more intriguing, someone whose name is met with admiration and respect. Two young art students are quick to be charmed by the power player she pretends to be, and together they embark on a tantalizing dance through the night, where the boundaries between art and exploitation blur and the truth waits just around the corner.

results.title: Mana ShankaraVaraPrasad Garu
results.overview: National security officer Vara Prasad, protecting his estranged wife and kids from a vengeful ex-cop, sees it as a chance to rebuild their relationship after six years apart.

results.title: Vowels
results.overview: A romantic anthology of five love stories exploring different dimensions: Attraction, Emotion, Intimacy, Obsession, and Unconditional love, each reflecting diverse emotional experiences.

results.title: Mil pedazos
results.overview: Miguel (55), Isabel (45), and Emilia (9) go on vacation with their dog, Eve. Suddenly, an accident in the middle of the desert leaves the mother seriously injured. Miguel, trying to save Emilia, embarks on a personal journey with his daughter to find answers about what happened. Three months later, Isabel awakens from a coma and begins a personal, loving, and intuitive quest to rebuild her family.

results.title: Scorcher
results.overview: Elaine, a young crowd canvasser, struggles to raise money for women’s reproductive healthcare on the hottest day of the summer. She’s on the brink of being fired and showing signs of heat exhaustion when a coworker approaches her about starting a canvassing union.

results.title: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
results.overview: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

results.title: Instrucciones Para Cocinar Un Pollo Bajo Tierra
results.original_title: Instrucciones Para Cocinar Un Pollo Bajo Tierra

results.title: Akāliko Hotel
results.original_title: อกาลิโก โฮเทล
results.overview: A story of love, greed, and betrayal among a group of people whose lives are intertwined. Now, the time has come for them to settle their past scores once and for all in order to find a way to escape the mysterious Akaliko Hotel.

results.title: Monument
results.overview: The military statue is absent, yet its presence reigns; it seems like an open wound. With each turn, more buds of time bloom. There are multiple rhythms and points of view in a brief, eternal moment. An exercise in the effect of speed and its personal interplay with the viewer. Photos taken at the scene on October 18, 2024, the fifth anniversary of the 2019 Social Uprising. 35mm B&W Still Photography. Silent. Flickering Lights.

results.title: Shores
results.overview: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

results.title: Rowing
results.overview: Nele’s whole life is centered around rowing. Together with her best friend Dina, she trains every single day without exception. But Dina is struggling with her own body – her skin is turning scaly and spikes start growing out of her back. While Nele tries to keep her focused on training, Dina decides to listen to her body and surrender to the transformation. Not only is their shared passion at risk of falling apart, so too is their friendship in jeopardy.

results.title: Deep Dive
results.overview: Take an exclusive look behind the scenes of The War Between the Land and the Sea.
